errors.text_span: The chart is divided into ten slices
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description states 10 slices, but then lists 14 subcategories plus the main layers. The reference describes 16 segments total (4 main inner slices + subcategories in outer ring).

errors.text_span: The chart is divided into ten slices, labeled as "Professional Knowl & Reasoning," "Culture of Speaker," "Imagination," "Acoustic Quality Analysis," "Signal Layer," "Semantic Layer," "Emotion & Intention," "Speaker Analysis," "Music Theory," "Counting & Statistics," "Environmental Perception & Reasoning," "Temporal Analysis," "Correlation Analysis," and "Spatial Analysis."
errors.evidence: The description lists 14 items after saying the chart is divided into 10 slices. Also, this description conflates the inner circle (main layers) with the outer circle (subcategories), failing to describe the donut/hierarchical structure. The chart is a multi-ring donut chart, not a simple pie chart.

The description fails to mention that the chart has two concentric rings (inner ring showing 4 main layers with percentages, outer ring showing subcategories), which is a critical structural feature of this visualization.

errors.text_span: The slices are colored in varying shades of blue and pink.
errors.evidence: The chart uses shades of blue and grey/purple, not pink. There is no pink coloring visible in the figure.
The reference explicitly states 'without a specific legend provided' and the figure does not show any legend. The machine-generated description incorrectly claims a legend exists.
The description does not mention that the center of the chart is white (hollow donut center), which is a notable visual feature.

errors.text_span: The segments are visually ordered with generally larger segments appearing towards the right side of the chart, and smaller segments towards the left.
errors.evidence: This characterization is inaccurate or misleading. The Perception Layer (largest at 40.4%) is on the left/bottom, and the Semantic Layer (41.2%) is on the right, but the Signal Layer (smallest at 4.3%) is at the top, not left. The ordering description does not accurately reflect the chart layout.
The description omits 'Content Analysis' and 'Aesthetic Analysis' which are subcategories visible in the outer ring under the Semantic Layer, and 'Audio Difference Analysis' under the Signal Layer.

errors.text_span: Some slices have percentage labels directly within the segment; the "Cultural Layer" slice is labeled as 14.1%, the "Semantic Layer" is labeled as 41.2%, and the "Signal Layer" is labeled as 4.3%. The "Perception Layer" represents the largest section of the pie chart, at approximately 40.4%.
errors.evidence: All four main layers have percentage labels within the inner ring slices (Cultural Layer 14.1%, Semantic Layer 41.2%, Signal Layer 4.3%, Perception Layer 40.4%). The description inconsistently lists three with exact labels and one 'approximately,' when all four are labeled in the figure.
